name: Quiz Builder by WiVi – Online Exam & Quiz Maker
author: infotheme

sections.description:
WiVi Quiz Maker helps you create interactive quizzes, online exams, and knowledge tests in WordPress. Build questions, choose question types, pick a theme, set scoring rules, and publish engaging quizzes anywhere on your website with a shortcode, Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, or classic sidebar widget.

This WordPress quiz plugin is built for educators, trainers, bloggers, and businesses who need a clear quiz maker without complexity. Create scored quizzes, true-or-false tests, multiple-choice exams, fill-in-the-blank questions, and more — then track attempts from your WordPress dashboard.

WordPress Quiz Maker plugin

  • WiVi Quiz Builder
  • Quiz plugin Documentation

Quiz shortcode
[wivi_quiz id=”123″]

Question types

  • Multiple Choice (Single) — one correct answer (MCQ)
  • Multiple Choice (Multi) — more than one correct answer
  • True / False — classic exam-style questions
  • Dropdown — choose one answer from a list
  • Short Text — type-in answers with accepted responses
  • Fill in the Blank — complete missing words
  • Number — numeric answers with optional tolerance
  • Date — pick a date as the answer
  • Info / Content — informational slides that do not affect the score

Quiz types you can build

Use this quiz maker to create trivia quizzes, scored exams, knowledge tests, IQ-style quizzes, yes-or-no / true-or-false quizzes, training assessments, and survey-style quizzes (hide or de-emphasize scoring with info questions and result messages). Score-band result messages let you show different outcomes based on the user’s percentage.

Creating a simple quiz

  1. Go to WiVi Quiz → Questions and add questions to your question bank (or create them inside the quiz builder).
  2. Go to WiVi Quiz → Quizzes and click Add New.
  3. Add a title, select questions, choose a theme, and configure scoring or timer options.
  4. Copy the shortcode from the Publish tab and paste it into a page or post.

That’s it. Your WordPress quiz is ready.

Customizable questions

Each question supports points, explanations, hints, correct/wrong messages, categories, tags, and optional media. Add a question image, answer images, a background image, or a YouTube / uploaded video. Mark questions as “no influence to score” when you want survey-style items inside a quiz.

Quiz settings

This WordPress exam and test plugin includes practical options for real quizzes:

  • Randomize questions
  • Randomize answers
  • Quiz timer with auto-submit behavior
  • Pass score with pass / fail messaging
  • Score-band / interval result messages
  • Show correct answers and explanations
  • Instant right / wrong feedback
  • One question per page or all questions on one page
  • Progress bar
  • Redirect users after quiz completion
  • Schedule quiz start and end times
  • Require login, role allowlist, or password / access codes
  • Max attempts (by user, IP, cookie, or email)
  • Max number of quiz takers
  • Negative marking

Quiz with timer

Enable a countdown timer for timed exams and online tests. When time runs out, the quiz can be submitted automatically — useful for classroom tests, certifications practice, and competitive quizzes.

Quiz results, scores and reports

After a quiz is completed, attempts are stored in your WordPress database. From WiVi Quiz → Results you can review scores, pass rates, averages, attempt details, and a leaderboard. Export results to CSV for analysis, email marketing, or offline reporting.

Frontend results can show percentage or correct-count scoring, pass/fail messages, score-band messages, answer review / solutions, rank among attempts, restart, social share, and an optional printable certificate for passed users.

Quiz themes, styles and live preview

Six designed quiz themes are included: Aurora, Strand, Pulse, Orbit, Bloom, and Scroll. Customize colors, width, buttons, progress, timer, and animations to match your site. Use live draft preview from the builder while you edit.

Question bank

Reuse questions across quizzes with a dedicated question bank. Organize questions with categories, insert them into any quiz, and import or export questions via CSV.

User data form

Collect name, email, and phone before or after the quiz. Use the data for follow-up, lead capture, or admin notifications. Optionally email results to the user and the admin with wp_mail.

Embed anywhere

  • Shortcode: [wivi_quiz id="123"]
  • Gutenberg block
  • Elementor widget
  • Classic sidebar widget
  • Pretty URL: /quiz/{id}/

Additional shortcodes

  • [wivi_quiz_results id="123"] — recent results for a quiz
  • [wivi_quizzes limit="10"] — list quizzes
  • [wivi_quiz_category slug="trivia"] — list quizzes in a category
  • [wivi_leaderboard] — site-wide leaderboard

Quiz social sharing

Let users share their quiz result via WhatsApp, Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Telegram, or Email to grow traffic and engagement.

Integrations

Optional integrations (only when you enable them and add your own credentials):

  • Google reCAPTCHA (spam protection)
  • Mailchimp
  • Zapier webhook
  • Slack incoming webhook
  • ActiveCampaign (webhook-style)
  • Google Sheets via Apps Script webhook

Features

  • Unlimited quizzes
  • Unlimited questions
  • 9 question types
  • Question bank with categories
  • CSV import / export for questions
  • Scoring, pass score, and negative marks
  • Score-band result messages
  • Quiz timer
  • Randomize questions and answers
  • Access codes / password protection
  • Login and role restrictions
  • Attempt limits and scheduling
  • Results dashboard with statistics
  • CSV export of attempts
  • Leaderboard shortcode
  • Six quiz themes and style controls
  • Live draft preview
  • Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, and sidebar widget
  • Social sharing on results
  • Printable certificate on pass
  • Email results to user and admin
  • Opt-in “Powered by” branding only (off by default)
  • No account or external license required to use the plugin

A free WordPress quiz maker to create quizzes, exams, and tests — give it a try!

In case of questions or suggestions, visit the plugin page or check the documentation.

External services

This plugin can optionally connect to third-party services that you configure. Nothing is sent until you enable the related setting and provide your own credentials (or a visitor completes a protected form).

Google reCAPTCHA

Used only when you enable reCAPTCHA in settings and provide site/secret keys. It helps reduce spam quiz submissions.

  • Data sent: reCAPTCHA response token and server IP on verification
  • Service: Google reCAPTCHA — Terms · Privacy

Mailchimp

Used only when you enable the Mailchimp integration and save an API key/list. On quiz submission, subscriber details may be synced to your Mailchimp list.

  • Data sent: name/email (and other form fields you collect) when a quiz is submitted
  • Service: Mailchimp — Terms · Privacy

Zapier

Used only when you enable Zapier and provide a webhook URL you control. Submission payloads can be posted to that webhook.

  • Data sent: quiz attempt summary / fields you map when a quiz is submitted
  • Service: Zapier — Terms · Privacy

ActiveCampaign

Used only when you enable ActiveCampaign and provide your own API URL and key. Quiz attempt data is posted to your ActiveCampaign account.

  • Data sent: quiz attempt summary (name, email, score) when a quiz is submitted
  • Service: ActiveCampaign — Terms · Privacy

Google Sheets (Apps Script webhook)

Used only when you enable the Google Sheets integration and paste a Google Apps Script web app URL that you created and control.

  • Data sent: quiz attempt summary when a quiz is submitted
  • Service: Google — Terms · Privacy

Slack

Used only when you enable Slack and provide an Incoming Webhook URL for your workspace.

  • Data sent: notification text about a quiz submission
  • Service: Slack — Terms · Privacy

Social share

Share buttons open WhatsApp / Facebook / X / LinkedIn / Telegram / Email using the visitor’s browser. No analytics are sent to InfoTheme.

This plugin does not phone home for analytics or licensing. Quiz attempts are stored in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
There are two easy ways to install this WordPress quiz plugin:

  • Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  • Go to Plugins → Add New.
  • Search for WiVi Quiz Builder.
  • Click Install Now, then Activate.

Or install from a zip file:

  • Download the plugin zip from wordpress.org (when available) or from the product page.
  • Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  • Choose the zip file and click Install Now, then Activate.

After activation, open WiVi Quiz → Quizzes and create your first quiz. Use the shortcode, block, or Elementor widget to embed it on any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I create a quiz?

Go to WiVi Quiz → Quizzes, click Add New, add a title, insert questions from the question bank or create them in the builder, choose a theme, set your scoring options, and save. Copy the shortcode from the Publish tab.

How do I create a question?

Go to WiVi Quiz → Questions, click Add New, enter the question text, choose a question type, add answers and mark the correct ones, then save. You can also create questions directly inside a quiz.

How do I insert a quiz into a page or post?

Copy [wivi_quiz id="Your_Quiz_ID"] from the quiz Publish tab (or Quizzes list) and paste it into the editor. You can also use the Gutenberg quiz block, Elementor widget, or sidebar widget.

How many question types are available?

Nine: Multiple Choice (Single), Multiple Choice (Multi), True/False, Dropdown, Short Text, Fill in the Blank, Number, Date, and Info/Content.

Is there a limit on quizzes or questions?

No plugin-imposed limit. You can create unlimited quizzes and unlimited questions. Very large quizzes may still be limited by your hosting PHP settings (for example max_input_vars).

Can I create a timed exam?

Yes. Enable the quiz timer in quiz settings. When time expires, the quiz can submit automatically — ideal for online exams and tests.

Where are quiz results stored?

Attempts are saved in a custom database table on your site. View them under WiVi Quiz → Results, including statistics and CSV export.

Can I protect a quiz with a password?

Yes. Use access codes / password protection in the Limitations settings. You can also require login, restrict by role, schedule availability, and limit attempts.

Does the plugin show “Powered by” branding?

No, not by default. Frontend attribution appears only if you enable the “Show Powered by branding” checkbox in WiVi Quiz → Settings.

Does this plugin require an account or external license?

No. The plugin works on your site without connecting to InfoTheme for licensing.

Can I translate this plugin?

Yes. Strings use the standard WordPress translation API with the text domain wivi-quiz-builder. You can translate them with tools such as Loco Translate.
sections.changelog:
1.12.3

  • All bundled integrations (Mailchimp, Zapier, Slack, ActiveCampaign, Google Sheets, reCAPTCHA) are fully enabled — no Pro gating anywhere in the plugin.
  • Integrations that are not implemented yet are clearly labeled “Coming soon” and disabled for everyone equally.
  • “Powered by” frontend branding is now off by default and strictly opt-in via an explicit settings checkbox.
  • Renamed all functions, classes, constants, options, hooks, post types, and script handles to the unique wivi_ / WIVI_ prefix (4+ characters).
  • Documented ActiveCampaign and Google Sheets external services in the readme.

1.12.2

  • Updated Plugin URI to the live product page.

1.12.1

  • Final display name and slug: WiVi Quiz Builder / wivi-quiz-builder.

1.12.0

  • WordPress.org uniqueness and ownership clarity rename.
  • Unlocked bundled features for free directory compliance (no locked local features).
  • Removed arbitrary custom CSS/JS fields.
  • Stopped loading Google Fonts from third-party CDNs.
  • Documented optional external services (reCAPTCHA, Mailchimp, Zapier, Slack).
  • Enqueued view/admin CSS via WordPress style APIs instead of raw style tags.

1.11.2

  • Previous We Quiz Maker packaging release.
